verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents inline request policies, such as Prompt Guards, rate limiting, guardrails and budget enforcement, that act on traffic passing through the gateway. That is a related but different capability from user-defined event-trigger rules that automatically run actions. The evidence shows no documented event-rule engine, alerting actions or trigger-to-action automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
